notes.title: Major update, adding in-game store where you can purchase cat nest/beds.
notes.content:
1. Add an in-game store where you can purchase cat nests/beds for cats to sleep on.

2. Increase the mechanism of earning money by picking up discarded plastic bottles and cans and selling them in stores.
3. Players need to earn money to purchase fishing rods, cat supplies, and food from stores.

4. Optimize the visual image by adding trees in the distant environment.
